purpose.zh: 扶着椅子练大腿和臀部力量，适合入门
purpose.en: Build thigh and glute strength with chair support, good for beginners.

text.zh: 臀部稍往后坐，小幅度往下蹲
text.en: Sit your hips back a little into a small squat

text.zh: 双手扶稳椅背，双脚踩实不动。
text.en: Hold the chair back with both hands and keep your feet planted.

text.zh: 膝盖对着脚尖，再踩地站起来。
text.en: Keep your knees in line with your toes, then push up to stand.

commonErrors.en: Leaning your weight on the chair.

cautions.zh: 用不带轮子的稳固椅子，站不稳就停
cautions.en: Use a sturdy chair without wheels, and stop if you feel unsteady.

cautions.zh: 膝盖疼时幅度小一点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your knees hurts, move less far, and stop if it still hurts.

changes: 底部只停 0.4 s，节奏用 rep_updown（派生的 1 s 停顿偏长）
